assessment: The source defines a discretized cubic lattice with spacing a and L sites along each dimension, then reports a=1.32 fm and L from 8 through 23, corresponding to physical side lengths of approximately 10 through 30 fm. The card’s physical_box_length=aL relation is the direct lattice geometry implied and numerically checked by those endpoint correspondences. Its spacing parameter, integer site-count control, physical-length readout, full discrete domain, N3LO applicability, and anchors are source-supported; the output is a deterministic geometric central value.

issues.detail: The source summarizes endpoint physical box sizes approximately as 10 and 30 fm; the exact card values are the deterministic products of the reported a=1.32 fm and integer L values.

controls.definition: Number L of lattice sites along each dimension of the periodic cubic lattice.
controls.name: sites_per_dimension

applicability.statement: Applies to the N3LO lattice calculations using a=1.32 fm; the reported L range corresponds approximately to physical box lengths from 10 fm to 30 fm.
L is a discrete lattice-site count because the system is solved on an L by L by L lattice.

readouts.definition: Physical side length of the cubic lattice box.
readouts.name: physical_box_length
